summary.headline: Q4 FY26 revenue rose 55% YoY to INR 343 crore and EBITDA margin hit 8.8%, while management guides FY27 revenue growth of 35-40%.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue from operations was INR 343 crore, up 55% YoY, with EBITDA up 202% to about INR 31 crore and margin at 8.8% (up 431 bps). PAT was INR 22 crore against a loss a year earlier. FY26 revenue was INR 1,068 crore (up 39%), EBITDA INR 101 crore (9.43% margin) and PAT INR 60 crore, with net working capital days down to 66 from 110. Q4 EBITDA absorbed an additional INR 5 crore expected credit loss and a non-cash unwinding item on long-term deposits, which management says it treats as a one-off adjustment.

financial_highlights.value: INR 142 crore (also cited as about INR 140 crore)

segments.name: B2B Supply
segments.commentary: Entry point to the network; contributed about 44% of FY26 revenue. Relationship-led, used to build transaction scale and pricing intelligence.

segments.name: Contract Manufacturing
segments.commentary: Revenue up 169% YoY in Q4; about 47% of FY26 revenue. Volumes delivered rose 91% YoY to 11.29 lakh MT and capacity utilisation rose to 50% from 39%.

segments.name: Services (DAAS)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 36 crore, up 264% YoY and 61% QoQ; about 9% of FY26 revenue. About 12+ active projects and INR 1,800+ crore GDV under execution; management says it carries significantly higher margins.

segments.name: Asphalt (new category)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 30 crore, up 88% QoQ; active customers nearly doubled to 28 in the quarter. Management cites 18-20% net profit with the partner manufacturer.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at about 35-40%; management expects EBITDA to grow faster than revenue as costs stay under control.
EBITDA margin sweet spot of about 10-10.5% (about 10-10.2% after excluding the INR 5 crore ECL); management said it will sustain at least this level.
Management aims to lock in about 85-90% of FY27 top line and matching bottom line in Q1 FY27.
Contract Manufacturing and Services targeted at 55-60% and 9-10% of revenue respectively over next 3-5 years.
Peak Contract Manufacturing utilisation targeted at 75-80% or more within FY27; annualised Q4 utilisation was said to be 65-70%.
Working capital facilities of INR 100-150 crore planned; INR 30 crore sanctioned by one bank. OCF-to-PAT ratio about 1:2 currently, expected about 1:1.5 next year.
Fresh vendor deposit investment of INR 25-50 crore planned in FY27 across customers and vendors.
Management said it is not giving a PAT target for FY27 when asked about INR 100 crore.
capex_capacity: Asset-light model: secures capacity via exclusive long-term partnerships with manufacturing plants and does not own the plants.
Current asset base offtake of about 9 million MT annually, equal to about INR 900-1,000 crore of material per year and about INR 4,000-5,000 crore over five years, per management.
Vendor/trade deposits of about INR 200-250 crore (about INR 160 crore in the prior figure cited) secure capacity; these are refundable and not interest-bearing.
Capacite multi-year contract worth about INR 800 crore over five years is additional contracted revenue; management says combined revenue visibility exceeds INR 6,000 crore over five years.
Management plans to add capacity every quarter and expand existing geographies rather than enter new ones.
demand_pricing: Serves over 3,000 customers through 2,000+ vendors across 23 states and UTs; more than 78% repeat order contribution.
Management says raw material price moves are a clear pass-through and not material to profitability; no commodity price risk, per the CEO.
Management says the gross margin pressure is driven by the ECL and cost structure, and the company does not focus on increasing brand or private-label strategy.
Customer wallet share ranges from 25-50% at top customers to 5-10% at very large companies.
Management cited inbound inquiries from larger contractors after the Capacite announcement; target market includes infra contractors as well as developers.

qa_highlights.question: Target mix for FY27 and whether INR 100 crore PAT is achievable at 40% growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 55-60% Contract Manufacturing and 9-10% Services is a fair assumption, but would not give a PAT number; it cited cost control, CM/Services mix and working capital days (44 days cited for the year) as drivers.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses spike in Q4 and why did interest cost rise?
qa_highlights.answer: Other expenses rose due to an additional expected credit loss of about INR 5 crore taken at year-end. Interest cost is higher because pre-listing debt was high in Q1 FY26; the company is now building working capital lines of INR 100-150 crore, with INR 30 crore sanctioned.

qa_highlights.question: Is EBITDA margin sustainable at around 11% in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided to a sweet spot of 10-10.5% EBITDA margin (about 10-10.2% excluding the INR 5 crore one-off), and said it will sustain that level.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Contract Manufacturing revenue potential on current asset base and deposits?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the 9 million MT offtake could support about INR 700-800 crore of annual material revenue at 75-80% peak utilisation; with the Capacite contract, revenue visibility exceeds INR 6,000 crore over five years.

qa_highlights.question: What is the nature of the INR 5 crore non-cash item and the deposits?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the deposits are non-interest-bearing and discounted to present value, creating a non-cash unwinding income of about INR 5 crore in Q4 that lifted other income and reduced reported EBITDA by the same amount; cash flows sit in investing.

qa_highlights.question: How much cash generation and capital allocation is planned?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said surplus cash will go into capacity and Services working capital, with OCF-to-PAT of about 1:2 now and about 1:1.5 next year; no hard OCF number was given.

risks_watch: Receivables: 180-plus day stuck receivables at about INR 40-42 crore, with management expecting significant recovery in FY27; receivables grew about 25-27% vs revenue growth of about 40%.
Q4 ECL of about INR 5 crore indicates a more conservative receivables stance; watch for whether this recurs.
Reported EBITDA is sensitive to discounting of non-interest-bearing long-term deposits, which management said is non-cash but affects EBITDA.
Working capital facility dependence: interest cost is rising while debt is reportedly lower; watch the INR 100-150 crore lines.
Watch Q1 FY27 for the 85-90% order-book lock-in and the announcement of further long-term contracts beyond Capacite.
Competitive moat is described as execution and relationships; management declined to comment on competitors and gave no quantified cost advantage.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on growth, the asset-light model and the five-year contract visibility. Evasive on the FY27 PAT target, the competitive landscape and the exact cost advantage, and it framed the interest cost and the Q4 EBITDA dip as one-offs or strategic.
key_quotes: We have taken an additional expected credit loss of about INR 5 crores.
We are in the business of funding the bridge between payables and receivables.
For us, it is a clear pass -through.

adds.what: Asset-light model; adds capacity via exclusive long-term partnerships with plants (no owned plants); management plans to add capacity every quarter
Current asset base offtake of about 9 million MT annually (INR 900-1,000 crore material per year) via partner plants

growth.why: Management guides FY27 revenue growth of about 35-40% and peak Contract Manufacturing utilisation of 75-80% within FY27 (annualised Q4 at 65-70%), backed partly by ~9 million MT annual offtake from partner plants, the Capacite contract (~INR 800 crore over five years), and a targeted 85-90% top-line lock-in in Q1 FY27, but no owned capacity additions with specific capex or timing were given.
